description: This file is a React component for a webpage, specifically the homepage, that fetches and displays recent posts (TripTales) with a server-side data fetching function and JSX rendering.

methods.name: fetchPosts
methods.description: Asynchronous function that constructs a URL based on environment variables, fetches data from the API endpoint, and returns a Promise resolving to an object containing an array of Post objects.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Default exported React component that fetches the posts and renders the main page content, including a header and a Suspense-wrapped PostGrid component.
